adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts at lines 24-26. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and the response lacks a refresh_token, the code sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (a literal string placeholder). Looking at Office365CalendarService.ts, the code does `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` which would merge this placeholder over any existing real refresh_token. If credential sharing is later disabled, the credential would have the literal string "refresh_token" instead of a valid token, breaking direct OAuth refresh with Microsoft.
